items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: But today when you go hear a band like Thad Jones and different bands, or Basie, everybody in the band can play because they have had the training and have access to the teaching, which we had to learn ourselves.

ctx.x: And that's beautiful because it's combining knowledge with talent. And that's why today you find a lot of good players. In the old days, you'd listen to a band playing, have one or two jazz guys get up and play a solo. And the other

guys just played the music. But today when you go hear a band like Thad Jones and different bands, or Basie, everybody in the band can play because they have had the training and have access to the teaching, which we had to learn ourselves.
You mentioned to me yesterday about Minton's, that you were up at Minton's when things were happening. Would you talk about that?
